title: Best to do the earlier...
text: Best to do the earlier tour as the Gothic Quarter gets very crowded.  The tour is well worth booking.  Great tour!
author: Perry_Z

title: Little Brooklyn (Pauly)in Barcelona!
text: You can walk at your own pace. The guide was very informative and friendly and lets you take breaks as you go along.
author: Patrice_Z

title: The walking tour of the Gothic Quarter was a great experience.
text: Our guide, Armando, took us deep into the Gothic Quarter and provided an interesting and rich history of the old town since Roman times. As we wound our way through the Gothic Quarter we stopped to examine old cathedrals and churches, the Temple D’August columns, and many medieval landmarks. Armando was friendly, attentive and extremely well-informed.
author: Dagoberto_G
